**About The Role**
Join a team building the backend services that power critical order management and omnichannel retail experiences.
  
  
As a Software Engineer on the Order Management team, you’ll help design, build, test, and support scalable services that manage complex order workflows. You’ll work with technologies including
**Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, relational and NoSQL databases**
, while gaining exposure to distributed systems, event-driven architecture, production observability, and modern engineering practices.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving problems, writing high-quality software, and taking ownership of the applications they help build—from development through production.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
* Build and support microservices and event-driven applications using technologies such as Kafka.
* Translate business requirements and functional specifications into technical solutions and production-ready code.
* Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to solutions that are scalable, maintainable, resilient, and aligned with engineering standards.
* Develop automated unit, integration, and behavior-driven tests using tools such as JUnit, Mockito, and Cucumber.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, including technologies such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
* Build observability into applications and use monitoring and logging tools such as Elasticsearch, Prometheus, and Grafana to understand application health and performance.
* Troubleshoot application and production issues, participate in root-cause analysis, and help implement solutions that improve reliability and prevent recurring problems.
* Use source control, build, and delivery tools such as Bitbucket, Maven, Gradle, and CI/CD pipelines as part of the software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with engineers, product partners, and other cross-functional teams to deliver solutions supporting order management workflows.
* Participate in code reviews, technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of team engineering practices.
* Evaluate new tools and technologies and contribute ideas that simplify development, testing, deployment, and operational processes.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* 2+ years of software development experience with hands-on experience developing backend applications using Java or a comparable object-oriented programming language.
* Experience developing applications using Spring Boot, microservices, APIs, or similar backend technologies.
* Experience with one or more of the following: event-driven or messaging technologies, relational or NoSQL databases, automated testing, CI/CD, or DevOps practices.
* Experience working within an Agile software development lifecycle and using modern source-control practices.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience developing applications with Java and Spring Boot.
* Experience building or supporting microservices and event-driven systems using Kafka or a comparable messaging platform.
* Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Cassandra, or similar technologies.
* Experience with automated testing tools and practices, including technologies such as JUnit, Mockito, or Cucumber.
* Experience supporting applications in production, including troubleshooting, monitoring, incident response, or root-cause analysis using tools such as Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar platforms.
* Experience with build, source-control, and delivery technologies such as Bitbucket, Maven, Gradle, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working with order management, retail, e-commerce, fulfillment, inventory, payments, or other transaction-oriented systems is a plus.

**Why Join Us?**

* Impactful Work: Shape the future of Order Management by building critical services that directly impact customer experience.
* Growth Opportunities: Continuous learning with the latest tech trends and opportunities to explore new tools and frameworks.
* Collaborative Environment: Work with smart, passionate people in a culture that values collaboration, inclusiveness, and innovation.
* Great Benefits: Competitive salary, flexible working hours, health benefits, and career development programs.

**Description**
Annapurna Labs builds custom Machine Learning accelerators that are at the forefront of AWS innovation and one of several AWS tools used for building Generative AI on AWS. The Neuron Compiler Engineering team is searching for a Software Development Engineer to support the development infrastructure of a compiler to enable the world's largest ML workloads to run efficiently in the cloud.
  
  
Amazon Annapurna Labs organization is responsible for silicon development at AWS. Organization covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software and operations. The AWS Neuron team works to optimize the performance of complex neural net models on our custom-built AWS hardware. More specifically, the AWS Neuron team is developing a deep learning compiler stack that takes neural network descriptions created in frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Jax, and converts them into code suitable for execution.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will be responsible for identifying and designing solutions that enable efficient and reliable build, test, and release mechanisms for the Neuron compiler. You will participate in design and implementation of a solution for distributed execution of the Neuron compiler that will help to run customer workloads more efficiently. You will leverage your technical communications skill as a hands-on partner to AWS ML services teams, bringing new products/features to market, and many other exciting projects.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Our Engineers Collaborate Across Diverse Teams, Projects, And Environments To Have a Firsthand Impact On Our Global Customer Base. You’ll Bring a Passion For Innovation, Data, Search, Analytics, And Distributed Systems. You’ll Also
  
  

* Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack.
* Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security.
* Build high-quality, highly available, always-on products.
* Research implementations that deliver the best possible experiences for customers.

A day in the life
  
  
As You Design And Code Solutions To Help Our Team Drive Efficiencies In Software Architecture, You’ll Create Metrics, Implement Automation And Other Improvements, And Resolve The Root Cause Of Software Defects. You’ll Also
  
  

* Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base.
* Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. You will collaborate closely with a cross-functional team comprised of compiler, hardware, and ML engineers.
* Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
